標題：精密煉金之父
內文：知名自然哲學與神祕學學者庫洛莫斯.洛薩基斯先生，正式創建自然哲學與化學技術學院，慷慨地將他在自然哲學領域的成就化為養分滋養後繼者。洛薩基斯先生長年扎根煉金領域，發表過許多令人歎為觀止的研究成果，他宣稱學術無分界，所有的知識都是在解密宇宙萬物，這個新的學院便是建立在這個原則上。
煉金領域一直以來都分裂成多個派系，各派擁躉紛爭不止，多名學者預測洛薩基斯先生創辦的學校將為這場漫長的戰爭畫上句點，他廣納各個領域的學者，催生出一項全新的概念：精密煉金，在數學法則與化學工藝的精確錨定下，結合神祕學宏大的視界，勢必將煉金領域帶領到全新的高度。

庫洛莫斯.洛薩基斯先生在失去蹤影三個月後，被其學生發現在他的一處住所昏迷不醒，身體並沒有任何衰敗與損傷，彷彿在被凝固在昏迷的那一秒鐘。據傳他家中有諸多金製家具與機關儀器，金子在他家中如同石頭般尋常。Kuromus Raskius先生的煉金研究是否已經超越了點石成金的境界?他又是為什麼昏迷?煉金學術界陷入了疑雲密佈的氛圍。 

庫洛莫斯.洛薩基斯先生的昏迷引起自然哲學、化學、神祕學界的轟動，自然哲學與煉金領域的巨擘齊聚一堂，在持續了天七天七夜的會議後，只得出了一個結論：Kuromus Raskius觸及了一個超出他生命層次的未知領域。
Content_en:
THE FATHER OF PRECISION ALCHEMY
        MISATARI, October 12. — Mr. Kuromus Raskius, the celebrated Scholar of Natural Philosophy and the Occult Arts, hath officially established the Academy of Natural Philosophy and Chemical Arts. In an Act of singular Munificence, Mr. Rosagis hath offered his Life’s Achievements in the Science of Nature to nourish those who shall follow in his Steps. Having been long rooted in the Alchemical Domain, and having published numerous Treatises that have awed the learned World, he doth declare that Knowledge admitteth no Boundaries, and that all human Enquiries serve but to decipher the Grand Fabric of the Universe. It is upon this sacred Principle that the new Academy is founded.

For Generations, the Realm of Alchymy hath been miserably divided into contending Factions, whose Adherents cease not from perpetual Strife. Many eminent Scholars now conjecture that the Academy erected by Mr. Rosagis shall put an End to this interminable War. By gathering curious Minds from every Knowledge, he hath brought forth a Concept hitherto unknown: Precision Alchymy. Anchored firmly upon Mathematical Laws and the exact Execution of Chemical Craft, yet guided by the vast Horizons of the Occult, this Science shall without Doubt elevate the Alchemical Arts to a Height never before witnessed by Mankind.         MISATARI, October 14. — Mr. Kuromos Raskius, after having been missing from all public Knowledge for the Space of three Months, was discovered by his Pupils in a State of deep Unconsciousness at one of his private Residences. Surprisingly, his Body showeth not the least Decay nor Injury, as though the Progression of Time itself had been frozen at the very Instant he fell into his stupor.

It is reported by those who entered the Premises that his Abode aboundeth with curious Furnishings and mechanical Instruments forged entirely of Solid Gold; in his Chambers, Gold appeareth as common and abundant as mere Pebble-stones. The learned World now asketh: Hath the Research of Mr. Raskius truly passed beyond the Transmutation of Lead into Gold? And what strange Force hath rendered him thus motionless? The Alchemical Faculties are presently cast into a Shadow of profound Suspicion and Bewilderment.        MISATARI, October 21. — The inexplicable stupor of Mr. Kuromus Raskius hath sent a profound Shock throughout the ranks of Natural Philosophy, Chymistry, and the Occult Sciences. In consequence, the most exalted Minds and Luminaries of the Alchemical Arts assembled in solemn Council, engaging in a debate that endured for seven Days and Nights.

Upon the Dawn of the eighth Day, the august Body reached but a single Conclusion: that Mr. Kuromus Raskius hath touched upon an unknown Realm—one that transcendeth the very Limitations of his mortal Existence.

西元1825年4月3日，一顆隕石墜落在米薩他利洲的法爾歐里基地區森林，造成三千萬棵樹木焚毀，所幸隕石墜落時已在空中爆炸，只餘下碎塊墜落地面，且森林人煙稀少，無人受傷。但森林大火持續燃燒三天，造成三分之二的森林面積就此化為荒土。隕石的來歷不明，在撲滅火勢的當天夜裡由無法解釋物質收容收藏館 米薩他利保管。

無法解釋物質收容收藏館 米薩他利的榮譽學者兼贊助者--庫洛莫斯.拉薩基爾斯先生，表示將率領收藏館麾下的煉金術士，投入隕石物質的研究。庫洛莫斯.拉薩基爾斯先生認為，這塊天外降臨的不速之客將成為延續煉金術士學術界的嶄新火種，照亮一條前人未曾踏足的道路。
"這將是我們翹首期盼的火種。"
Content_en:
”If there were a deity of flames, 
their true form would surely look just like that.”
On April 3, 1825, a meteor fell in the forests of the Farroriki base 
area on the continent of Misatari, igniting a blaze that destroyed 
thirty million trees.Fortunately, the meteor exploded mid-air, 
leaving only fragments to hit the ground. As the forest was 
sparsely populated, there were no injuries. However, the fire 
continued for three days, reducing two-thirds of the forest to 
desolate ash. The meteor’s origin remains unknown, and on 
the night the fire was extinguished, it was taken into custody 
by the Misatari Repository of Unexplainable Objects.

The esteemed scholar and benefactor of the Misatari Repository 
of Unexplainable Objects, Mr. Kuromus Raskius, has announced 
that he will lead the institute’s alchemists in researching the 
material of the fallen meteorite. Mr. Kuromus Raskius believes 
that this uninvited visitor from beyond will become a fresh 
spark to advance alchemical studies, illuminating a path never 
before explored.
”This will be the flame we have long awaited.”

西暦1825年4月3日、ミササタリ州ファルオリ基地エリアの森に隕石が落下し、3千万本の樹木が焼失しました。幸いにも隕石は空中で爆発し、破片のみが地面に落ち、人がほとんどいない森のため、負傷者はいませんでした。しかし、森の火災は3日間燃え続け、森林面積の3分の2が荒れ地と化しました。隕石の由来は不明であり、火災が鎮火したその夜、説明不可能物質収容コレクション館ミササタリによって保管されました。

説明不可能物質収容コレクション館ミササタリの名誉学者でありスポンサーでもあるクロムスラサキス氏は、コレクション館に属する錬金術師たちを率いて隕石物質の研究に着手すると発表しました。クロムスラサキス氏は、この天から舞い降りた“招かれざる客”が、錬金術の学術界に新たな火種をもたらし、かつて誰も歩んだことのない道を照らすだろうと述べました。

- 誰也沒想到土星環中有環的意象，竟是是縮放自如的密碼
Content_en:
- When stirred by Verdant Aurum, the mark of Mercury unveileth the power of transposition.

- Venus heralds the turning of sun and moon, and through Verdant Aurum, that turning is made evermore.

- I have long believed Jupiter to embody replication and expansion around a central force — and the results were as expected.

- The secret of Saturn’s halo, a ring within rings, proved to be a cipher for endless scale.
Content_ja:
- 水星のシンボルは ヴァーダント・オーラム（Verdant Aurum）によって駆動され、物体の位置を入れ替える力を生み出す。

- 金星は日と月の巡りを象徴しており、ヴァーダント・オーラムとの結合によりその力がさらに強化された。

- 私は常に、木星は中心を囲む複製と拡張を象徴していると考えていたが、やはりその通りだった。

- 誰も予想していなかったが、土星の輪には「輪」という概念そのものが隠されており、それは自在にスケーリングできるコードだったのだ。

Name_ja: 最終パターンのヒント
Content_zh-TW:
火焰與觸媒以等價比例，座落於中央並賦予其燃料。
觸媒之母育有四子，燃料南北端不可侵入四子領地。

太陽凝聚成平常一半的大小，於觸媒之母的邊境，
與燃料尖端交會處鎮守著。
三個尖端被火焰覆蓋，三個尖端裸露在外。
Content_en:
Let flame and catalyst be bound in equal measure,
placed at the heart, and granted its sustaining fuel.
The Mother of Catalysts beareth four offspring;
yet the fuel’s northern and southern tips shall 
not trespass upon their sacred dominion.

The Sun, condensed to half its common form,
stands sentinel at the borders of the Mother’s realm,
where its edge meets the sharpened point of the fuel.
Three of the points are veiled in flame,
while three remain uncovered, laid bare to mortal sight.
Content_ja:
炎と触媒は等しき比で結び、その中心に座し、燃料を授けよ。
触媒の母は四つの子を抱く。されど燃料の北と南の尖端、
その四つの子の域を侵すべからず。

太陽は常の半ばに縮められ、触媒の母の境界にて
燃料の尖端と交わりし守護者とならん。
三つの尖端は炎に包まれ、
残りの三つは覆われず、裸のまま顕わる。
